app.name: Family Tree
app.prototype: Prototype with a sample family. Changes are not saved.
login.title: Sign in
login.invite: This family tree is private. You can join only through an invite link from a relative.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask a close relative to start a reset for you.
home.stats: {people} people in the tree · joined so far: {joined}
home.nudgesDone: Your close family's details are complete.
home.approvals: {n} suggested edits are waiting for approval
nudge.name: A relative's name is missing
nudge.living: Is {name} living? Let the family know
tree.title: Family tree
tree.hint: Drag to move · pinch to zoom · tap a person
person.minorNote: Only parents and admins can change a child's details.
person.suggestNote: Your suggestion goes to a close relative or an admin to approve.
person.notFound: This person isn't in the tree.
phone.rule: Numbers are visible only to parents, children, brothers, sisters and spouse.
relation.title: How are we related?
relation.none: Not connected in the tree yet.
relation.described: The family has no name for this relationship yet, so admins have been asked to add one.
news.title: Family news
audience.branch: One branch: a person and all their descendants
news.previewSms: Relatives without WhatsApp ({sms}) will get a short SMS, which is paid.
news.demiseNote: Demise notices are always emailed and cannot be muted.
admin.title: Admin
admin.ownSuggestion: Your own suggestion: another admin or close relative must approve it.
admin.termsNote: Local Kanyakumari terms appear in the app only after you confirm them with the family elders.
admin.missingNone: None found yet. They appear here when someone looks up an unnamed relationship.
app.prototypeFamily: Prototype with the family from the 2011 spreadsheet. Changes are not saved.
news.empty: No announcements yet. Share the first family news.
tree.holdHint: Press and hold anyone you can edit for more options.
menu.removeConfirmBody: This removes {n} family link{s}: others linked only through them (e.g. a child or spouse) stay in the tree.
admin.dataExportNote: Download every person and family link as two CSV files you can open and edit in Excel. These are the same files used to load data into Supabase, so edits made here can be pushed there later.
admin.dataImportNote: Edited the files in Excel? Upload both here to update this prototype. This replaces every person and link currently shown, so save a copy of what you download first. Signed-in members must stay in the file.
admin.dataSupabaseNote: This only updates the prototype in your browser. To update the real database, use the uploaded files with scripts/import-seed.mjs, or paste them through scripts/seed-to-sql.mjs as before.
login.failed: Phone/email or password is not right. Try again, or ask a relative to help you reset it.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin.invitesNote: Creates a one-time link, valid for 7 days. Share it with a relative over WhatsApp so they can verify their email and set their own password.
admin.invitesPhoneNote: Phone numbers are recorded but not yet verified by SMS — that needs an SMS provider, which is a paid service Siddique hasn't turned on yet.
admin.invitesNewProfile: Not in the tree yet — they'll add themselves
admin.invitesLinkReady: Share this link once — it won't be shown again.
admin.invitesShareText: You've been invited to our family tree. Open this link to join: {link}
join.title: Join the family tree
join.noToken: This invite link looks incomplete. Ask whoever sent it for the full link.
join.emailIntro: Enter your email and we'll send a 6-digit code to verify it's yours.
join.detailsIntro: Almost done. Add your phone number and set a password.
join.phoneNote: Not verified by SMS yet — just recorded on your profile for now.
join.phoneInvalid: Phone must include the country code, e.g. +91XXXXXXXXXX.
join.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.
